recognize_zh: 這不是顯微鏡影像，而是手繪示意圖「Figure 1A」：血管內皮、白血球、紅血球、血小板皆為未活化狀態、自由流動且無黏附，代表正常血流環境；可與 Figure 1B 的活化血栓發炎狀態對照。注意此圖為 1A，與標題「1b」不符。
features: Hand-drawn schematic of a blood vessel lumen labeled FIGURE 1A
Unactivated endothelial cells lining both walls
Free-flowing unactivated leukocytes, red cells and platelets without adhesion or aggregates
No NETs, microparticles, thrombin or cytokines depicted
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic, hand-drawn schematic (labeled Figure 1A) rather than a microscopic image. It depicts a normal vessel lumen in which unactivated leukocytes, red cells and platelets circulate freely past quiescent endothelial cells, with no adhesion, aggregates or procoagulant mediators. It serves as the baseline for comparison with the activated thromboinflammatory milieu of myeloproliferative neoplasms shown in Figure 1B. Note that the image is Figure 1A, whereas the title and description refer to Figure 1B.
